description: This file defines the AccessMcpResourceTool class, a specialized tool for accessing MCP resources within a larger application. It includes methods for parsing parameters, executing resource access with approval and error handling, and handling partial requests.

classes.name: AccessMcpResourceTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to facilitate access to MCP resources, including parameter parsing, execution, and partial handling.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into structured AccessMcpResourceParams.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the resource access operation, including approval, error handling, and response formatting.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial requests by removing closing tags and prompting for user approval.
